cap_recommendations_future_only.rationale_combined_cap: Sum of independent additive sources (affinity 6 + DW 5 + small collection contribution if any non-PvP exception) MUST stay below an authoritative combined PvP cap, enforced by a future global modifier cap resolver before any runtime activation.

current_application_to_battle_engine.collection_synergy_v2: none (CS2-B resolver inert, not imported by battle_engine)
current_application_to_battle_engine.affinity_phase_2: none (AF2-A catalog inert, AF2-B economy/cap policy design-only)
current_application_to_battle_engine.boss_policies: none (matrices/policies design-only, not consumed by live battle_engine)

stacking_risks_if_all_activated_later.description: If all four systems (Collection, Affinity, DW, Skill Kit modifiers) emit additive PvP buffs simultaneously, naive sum could exceed the 12% combined PvP cap.
stacking_risks_if_all_activated_later.mitigation: Implement a global_modifier_cap_resolver BEFORE any runtime activation. PvP cap MUST be authoritative; non-PvP can keep system caps.

stacking_risks_if_all_activated_later.description: If any system applies multiplicatively rather than additively, effective buff can compound far beyond intended caps.
stacking_risks_if_all_activated_later.mitigation: Forbid multiplicative stacking in the initial activation; explicit balance review required before allowing any multiplicative source.

stacking_risks_if_all_activated_later.description: If the Faction x Element axis mismatch (dark vs darkness, missing tides) is not resolved, a runtime resolver may silently miss matrix rows and emit zero-resistance defaults, swinging PvP balance.
stacking_risks_if_all_activated_later.mitigation: AXIS-A activation gate must pass before any Faction/Element runtime ON.

stacking_risks_if_all_activated_later.description: A hero who contributes to a Collection Synergy AND has Affinity tier 4 AND equips a Divine Weapon could double/triple count if the same stat is buffed by all three.
stacking_risks_if_all_activated_later.mitigation: Same-stat sources MUST be unioned and clamped by the global cap resolver. No double-counting.

stacking_risks_if_all_activated_later.description: If any future runtime activation forgets the Borea hidden invariant, hidden hero data could leak through synergy/affinity/DW previews.
stacking_risks_if_all_activated_later.mitigation: Central Borea visibility resolver consulted by every runtime activation; unit tests required.

global_modifier_cap_resolver_requirement.name: global_modifier_cap_resolver_future
responsibilities: Aggregate additive PvP modifiers across Collection, Affinity, Divine Weapons, Skill Kit, Boss interactions
Reject orphan faction/element tokens not present in live roster (or covered by alias map)
Honor Borea hidden invariant; never include hidden hero contributions

activation_gates_summary: Cap policy ratification (CS2 / AF2 / DW combined)
